User.title: User
User.description: User account details for platform admins and employers

uid.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID of the user

email.description: The email address of the user

name.description: The full name of the user

role.description: The role of the user on the platform

businessName.description: The name of the business (required for employers)

createdAt.description: When the user account was created

Worker.title: Worker
Worker.description: Worker digital profile for receiving tips

employerId.description: The UID of the employer who onboarded this worker

name.description: The full name of the worker

position.description: The job position of the worker, e.g. Waiter, Barista

bankCode.description: The bank code for Paystack payouts

accountName.description: Verified bank account name of the worker

subaccountCode.description: Paystack generated subaccount code for splitting tips

createdAt.description: When the worker profile was created

Tip.title: Tip
Tip.description: Tip transaction details with automated split data

id.description: The Paystack transaction reference or unique transaction ID

workerId.description: The ID of the tipped worker

workerName.description: Captured name of the worker at physical transaction moment

employerId.description: The ID of the employer who onboarded the worker

amount.description: Total tip amount entered by customer in local currency NGN

workerAmount.description: Net payout to the worker (98% of amount)

users.description: Root collection storing platforms admins and registered business employers

workers.description: Root collection storing public profiles of staff eligible to receive tips via QR scan

tips.description: Root collection tracking transaction ledger and split payout percentages
